subject: Stakeholder catalog & approval timeline needed for HealthCorp pilot
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.l@redwood.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.g@healthcorp.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@healthcorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.c@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.b@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: quick recap + request for stakeholder roster and approval timeline

Hi Samir / Priya — thanks again for the 30-min demo today. Recap and asks below: 

Call recap (high level)
- Use case: inference latency-sensitive triage routing for clinical summaries (MedSummarizer).
- Success metrics: 99th pct latency < 350ms, 90% fewer manual triage steps, target pilot throughput ~50 reqs/sec.
- Constraints: PHI-sensitivity, on-prem proof point likely required, procurement windows end of Q4.

Immediate asks / next steps
1) Can you share a compact stakeholder roster (names, roles, emails) for the pilot signoff path: economic buyer, primary technical owner, InfoSec contact, procurement lead, and legal reviewer? A simple org chart or a spreadsheet is perfect.
2) Any known procurement deadlines / RFP windows we should plan around?
3) Please confirm required compliance evidence (SOC2, data residency, logging/audit specs) — I attached a SOC2 evidence checklist to make this easier.

Attachments: Redwood-MAP-v1.pdf (mutual action plan), SOC2-evidence-checklist.xlsx (light checklist).

Proposed next step: once we have the roster I’ll send a short one-pager for the economic buyer (TCO + pilot success metrics) and propose a 15-min security intro with our Head of Security. Are you available next week for that?

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[jasmine.l@redwood.com]

From: Samir Gupta <samir.g@healthcorp.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.l@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@healthcorp.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T09:05:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: quick recap + request for stakeholder roster and approval timeline

Hi Jasmine — great demo, thanks. Quick answers: 

Stakeholders (high level)
- Economic buyer: Priya Rao, VP Product (priya.rao@healthcorp.com)
- Technical owner / champion: Arjun Mehta, Director ML Platforms (arjun.m@healthcorp.com)
- InfoSec: Kavita Sharma, Head of InfoSec (kavita.s@healthcorp.com) — she typically owns security reviews and evidence requests.
- Procurement lead: Raj Patel (raj.p@healthcorp.com) / procurement@healthcorp.com
- Legal reviewer: Melissa Cruz (melissa.cruz@healthcorp.com) — she’ll need the SOW and DPA.

Procurement timing
- Internal RFP window opens 2026-11-01, approvals expected by mid-December. If you can get a pilot commercial summary and security brief into our procurement queue before 10/20, it will speed reviews.

We’ll put together a quick org chart and the procurement contacts spreadsheet and send by EOD tomorrow.

Samir
Director of Applied AI, HealthCorp

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.l@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.c@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.b@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.p@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: HealthCorp roster coming — who owns which deliverable?

Ben / Lauren / Olga — Samir confirmed stakeholders and will send the org chart + procurement contacts. Action items I want to assign so we move fast: 

- Ben: draft a 1-page commercial summary aimed at Priya (VP Product). Focus: pilot scope, expected ROI drivers, simplified TCO comparison vs current infra. Target: 1 page, two pricing scenarios (pilot vs 12mo). Due: 10/06.
- Lauren: own the mutual action plan updates and a short pilot runbook (success metrics + acceptance criteria). Due: 10/08.
- Olga: prep a 10-slide security briefing tailored to Kavita (InfoSec). Include SOC2 mapping, data flow, encryption approaches, and on-prem options. If you need specific compliance artifacts, I’ll forward the SOC2 checklist Samir requested. Due: 10/09.

Ben — if there’s any discount guardrail I should offer proactively to keep procurement moving, flag it here.

Thanks — I’ll ping once the org chart arrives and then coordinate scheduling.

Jasmine

From: Priya Rao <priya.rao@healthcorp.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.l@redwood.com>, Samir Gupta <samir.g@healthcorp.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.p@healthcorp.com>, procurement@healthcorp.com
Date: 2026-10-03T08:45:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: quick recap + request for stakeholder roster and approval timeline

Jasmine — attaching the org chart and procurement contacts as discussed. Quick callouts on decision criteria so you can tailor materials: 

Decision criteria (priority order):
1) Compliance and evidence (SOC2 + data residency)
2) Predictable latency / SLA (esp. 99th pct)
3) Total cost of ownership over a 12-month window
4) Integration effort (connectors to our MedSummarizer pipeline)

Attachments: HealthCorp-OrgChart.pdf, RFP-Procurement-Contacts.xlsx

We’d like a short 15-min security intro between Kavita and your security lead, and a 15-min commercial intro for Priya and the product steering committee. Proposed windows: 10/06 09:00–10:00 ET or 10/07 14:00–15:00 ET. Let me know what you can do.

Thanks,
Priya Rao
VP Product, HealthCorp

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.l@redwood.com>
To: Priya Rao <priya.rao@healthcorp.com>, Samir Gupta <samir.g@healthcorp.com>, Raj Patel <raj.p@healthcorp.com>, procurement@healthcorp.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.c@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.b@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.p@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-03T10:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: quick recap + request for stakeholder roster and approval timeline — proposed times

Thanks Priya / Samir — received, appreciate the clarity on criteria. 

We can cover both intros in short sessions. Proposed scheduling: 
- Security intro (Kavita <-> Olga Petrov, Redwood Head of Security): 10/06 at 09:30 ET (20 min)
- Commercial product intro (Priya + product steering committee): 10/07 at 14:00 ET (15–20 min)

Ben will send the 1-page commercial summary by end of day 10/06; Lauren will update the MAP; Olga will circulate the 10-slide security deck and attach the SOC2 evidence inventory. I’m attaching a lightweight security briefing to keep Kavita’s team oriented before the call.

Attachments: security-briefing-deck.pdf

If those times work, I’ll calendar and include the meeting purpose / pre-reads. If procurement needs formal SOW/DPA drafts ahead of time, Raj — please indicate the required routing.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[jasmine.l@redwood.com]
